def transform(grid):
    """Combine the two 4x4 panels when their colored masks are disjoint.

    If they collide anywhere, retain the left panel; otherwise overlay colors.
    """
    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]
    collision = any(left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0
                    for r in range(4) for c in range(4))
    if collision:
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] if left[r][c] else right[r][c]
             for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
